visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair and earrings sits on a textured brown sofa in front of a white tiled wall. She wears a tan, sleeveless dress and a small black lapel microphone. She speaks expressively, using her hands to emphasize her points. A white plush pumpkin sits beside her on the couch. (2) The scene transitions to an indoor room featuring a brown grand piano and music stands. Two young boys in t-shirts are visible; one holds and plays a violin while the other sits at the piano keyboard. A hand reaches into the frame from the right side, appearing to guide the boy's violin position. (3) The woman and the two boys are together in a brightly lit indoor space with white walls and silver fixtures, likely a bathroom or dressing room. The woman smiles warmly, holding the boys close as they all look into the camera. The boys have animated expressions while talking. (4) The boys are on a professional stage with a dark backdrop and a large black grand piano. They are dressed in formal white button-down shirts and dark trousers. They bow deeply to an unseen audience. In the bottom corner, a hand holding a smartphone is visible recording their performance.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a mother's emotional journey from doubting her child's musical focus to expressing pride in his first collaborative stage performance with his brother. It aims to share an inspiring family milestone and encourage trusting children's abilities.
